G40 readings stated before any A08 line is written, changing no rule: (1) the event's end marked ('Place is over', 'r/place has ended') is P12's 'marking the end' but not a record of what happened to the work, so it is not A08's second end, and a post that marks the end and thanks the makers is a marking (AcePlace-038); (2) a claim that the work survived, held, stayed on the final canvas or was etched permanently is P11 (the work said to have lasted, G16) and P12 (its fate, G13) at once, so as the room's first marking it makes the line J, and where a request for or saving of an image, timelapse or list of changes follows, the line is J with the mechanism later (JM, as A06 counted it), counted apart as joint; (3) a final image posted as done, or an image or link in the marking post, holds both ends (oman-023, bangtan-051); (4) a retelling of what happened to the work is P12's record (its range: a full account of the week), so a retelling after a marking shows the order (msu-047, greece-056); (5) marking another room's work or an alliance is not the room's marking of its own work (madokamagica-038, twitchplayspokemon-055); (6) a report that a marked work is gone is a record of what happened to it, so the order shows, after G39's reading 6 (metroid-051)
